# Dataset card

## Selected data

**No real public gaming telemetry was selected or downloaded.** The working demo uses a deterministic synthetic event fixture generated by `src/playerpulse/synthetic_data.py`. The fixture is designed to exercise labeling, preprocessing, training, scoring, and monitoring; it does not describe a real game, game studio, or player population.

For each synthetic player, the generator simulates sessions for 30 past days and 14 future days. It labels churn when no session is present in the future window. Only past sessions are aggregated into `sessions_7d`, `sessions_30d`, `playtime_7d_hours`, `playtime_30d_hours`, and `days_since_last_session`. The simulated outcome depends on realized future events, not an independent churn flag.

## Candidate evaluation and exclusions

The [IEEE Game Data Mining Competition rules](https://cilab.gist.ac.kr/gdmc2017/index.php/rule/) describe Blade & Soul logs but require joining a Google Group for raw-file download links. The [IEEE paper record](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8584127/) describes the commercial-game churn task. This environment did not obtain the files or verify permission to use or redistribute them, so they are excluded.

A reviewed 300-install mobile-game sample page ([sample and download links](https://databasesample.com/datasets/mobile-game-player-churn-label-sessions-and-purchases)) explicitly says the D30 churn flag was drawn independently of its activity columns. That data cannot support this task and is excluded. The sample page's CC0 declaration is not treated as evidence about unrelated game data.

## Data contract and quality

- Unit: one synthetic player snapshot; one record per player.
- Label: no qualifying session during the 14 days after the prediction timestamp; only complete follow-up windows are eligible.
- Time: timestamped install and prediction time; split chronologically into train, validation, and test with disjoint players.
- Checks: required columns, non-empty dataset, valid timestamps, unique player references, finite/non-negative feature values, binary labels, consistent 7/30-day count and duration windows, and bounded recency.
- Exclusions: player identifiers, future activity, simulator propensity, and non-activity attributes.
- Privacy: no real telemetry or identifiers; API caller references are HMACed before persistence.
- License: no third-party game telemetry is claimed. Synthetic generator source is included in this repository.
- Version/reproduction: `synthetic-events-v1`; seed and code/package versions are recorded in model metadata. Regenerate with `python -m playerpulse.train --output-dir artifacts/models/playerpulse-synthetic-v1`.
- Checksum: data are generated deterministically on demand; no external raw-data file is bundled or checksummed.

## Intended use and limitations

Use only to exercise an engineering and ML pipeline. Do not use scores for real player decisions, claim predictive validity, or make business outcome statements. The simulation has simplified hand-chosen engagement rates. Valid research requires a representative, time-stamped, properly licensed dataset with confirmed observation coverage and a documented data governance review.
